summary: The market is flat and range-bound for a third straight check. The Nifty sits on Thursday's close while the Sensex holds a small gain, with metals firm and midcap IT and fintech sold.

detail.leaders: Metals (Welspun Corp, Hindustan Zinc, Adani Enterprises); L&T
detail.laggards: IT (OFSS, Infosys, Mphasis); PB Fintech among midcaps
detail.tone: Unchanged from 10:30: the Nifty is pinned at 23,063 and the Sensex gain has narrowed to about 58 points. Pockets of buying in metals are offset by steady selling in IT and insurance-linked names.
watch: A break of the 23,000–23,100 band either way
Further selling in IT if the US 10-yr yield rises
Any US–Iran Hormuz headline moving Brent
